versions.changelog:
Initial release — a complete closed-loop English learning engine for Chinese speakers using TV series and movies.

- One-stop workflow: input any TV episode or movie name/code to start a guided learning loop (words, listening, reading, speaking, writing, review).
- Agent autonomously retrieves and verifies public subtitles, prioritizing legality and non-infringement (no storage or unauthorized usage).
- Offers pre-learning CEFR proficiency diagnostics (by exam score or adaptive quiz).
- Generates structured learning outputs (words, listening, annotation, and tasks) in multiple formats (HTML, Anki, Excel, Word, Markdown).
- Supports both TV series and films, with workflow tailored for Chinese native speakers.
- Each reply includes author attribution and a legal disclaimer.
